services_preview.title:
The right words.
The right support.
services_preview.intro: From a medical appointment to an important document, we help people understand one another with accuracy, care, and cultural awareness.

items.title: Document Translation
items.description: Clear, accurate translations of official documents, letters, forms, and outreach materials. Careful attention to both language and context.

items.title: Interpretation
items.description: An interpreter for the conversations that matter: appointments, school conferences, legal meetings, and community events. On-site, by phone, or by video.
items.image_alt: Two professionals from different backgrounds in a focused conversation, representing live interpretation

items.title: Cultural & community support
items.description: Language support grounded in cultural understanding, helping organizations reach immigrant, refugee, and multilingual communities.
items.image_alt: A diverse group of women engaged in a respectful, attentive conversation around a shared table

how_it_works.title:
Tell us what you need.
We’ll take it from there.
how_it_works.intro: A straightforward process, with a person to help you at each step.

steps.title: Start a conversation
steps.description: Share your language pair, the setting, and when you need support. We’ll follow up with a quote and next steps.

steps.title: Find the right match
steps.description: We match your request with an interpreter or translator who understands your language pair and the setting.

steps.title: Connect with confidence
steps.description: Meet in person, connect by phone or video, or receive your translated documents. Our team helps coordinate the details.

who_we_serve.audiences_footnote: On-site and remote sessions for appointments, meetings, intakes, school conferences, community events, and case management.
who_we_serve.title:
For the people
in your community.
who_we_serve.intro_1: We work with the organizations and individuals who make everyday life possible—from local schools and clinics to families navigating a new language.
who_we_serve.cultural_p1: Language carries context, culture, and lived experience. We bring that understanding to every conversation and every page.
who_we_serve.intro_2: Our work is rooted in Maine’s multilingual communities, with experience across African languages and languages spoken around the world.
who_we_serve.cultural_p2: We work across a wide range of African languages and world languages. See the full list on our Languages page.
